Full K2 support remains deferred for ESIR 1.4.0. The later generic cryo-temperature reconciliation repairs out-of-range paired transfers against their actual fluid identity, covering the earlier kr-ammonia minimum-temperature failure mechanism while retaining native core temperatures. Isolated changed-range and renamed-fluid fixtures do not accept the full K2 combination, progression or save migration; retain affected saves on preserved 2.0 pending that review. See CRYO_TEMPERATURE_COMPATIBILITY.md.

Route replacement rocket productivity to all four ESIR manufacturing recipes at each level's original value, removing the silo bridge bonus; Rigor targets unrelated random products instead of changing conserved crystal-return odds. Final native data contains 600 valid return recipes. Published Muluna forces its easy rocket setting true; expanded research is not an available supported setting. Interstellar-science age classification still needs progression review.
Remove additional technology unlocks only for recycling recipes deliberately retired by ESIR.

info.name: minigun-turret-HD
info.title: Minigun Turret HD
info.author: aRighteousGod
info.description: Adds a minigun turret and HD graphics. Supports the base game and Space Age.

info.name: distant-misfires-2_1-fork
info.title: Distant Misfires — Factorio 2.1 Fork
info.author: DataCpt; Factorio 2.1 fork by ixil
info.description: Factorio 2.1 fork by ixil of Distant Misfires, originally created by DataCpt. Dynamically replaces boring auto-aim bullets with skilfully inaccurate projectiles. Extends the max range of misfires alongside a magazine size increase. Let the biters experience true bullet hell. All configurable.

info.name: fire-lights-fork
info.title: Fire Lights (2.1 Fork)
info.author: DataCpt
info.description: Adds lights to fires, explosions, muzzle flashes, bullets, rockets, projectiles and more! Fully customisable!

info.name: diurnal-dynamics-fork
info.title: Diurnal Dynamics (2.1 Fork)
info.author: DataCpt
info.description: Make nights pitch black, customise the lengths of day/night cycles, enable night only attacks and darken space platforms/distant planets as they get further from the sun!

info.name: light-overhaul
info.title: Light Overhaul
info.author: Earendel
info.description: Changes the game's light settings with LUTs. Nights feel darker but have higher contrast. The character has a wider flashlight cone. Nightvision does not desaturate everything. A standalone version of the lighting changes from AAI Industry.

info.name: Pro-Flashlight
info.title: Pro Flashlight
info.author: MrAlwaysAwesome
info.description: Automatically turns and shines the flashlight on any selected entity when standing still.

info.name: visible-pollutants
info.title: Pollution: Impactful Smog / Spore Cloud
info.author: somethingtohide
info.description:
Pollution appears as a visible smog (or spore) cloud, covering your factory. The more you pollute, the less you can see.

Optionally reduce solar power effectiveness based on how much pollution is over each panel, to promote placing panels far away from heavily polluted areas.

info.name: colorful_biochamber
info.title: colorful_biochamber
info.author: meifray
info.description: RGB Biochamber.

info.name: celestial-weather-updated
info.title: Celestial Weather (2.1 Fork)
info.author: Varaxia
info.description: Adds static weather and visual effects to planets, including modded ones. Everything is toggleable in the settings.

info.name: DiscoScience
info.title: Disco Science
info.author: Daniel Brauer
info.description: Science labs light up with the colour of the ingredients they're consuming, instead of always blue. More advanced recipes make a fancier show! If it's slowing down your game, try turning off "high quality" in the mod options.

info.name: heat_glow-temp-21-patch
info.title: Heat Glow (Temporary 2.1 Patch)
info.author: OwnlyMe
info.description:
UNOFFICIAL TEMPORARY FACTORIO 2.1 PATCH. This is not an official update and should be deprecated when the original mod supports Factorio 2.1.

Original mod by OwnlyMe: https://mods.factorio.com/mod/heat_glow
Original version: 2.0.3

ORIGINAL DESCRIPTION:
Prettier heat glow

info.title: Shield FX (Fork 2.1)
info.author: OwnlyMe
info.description:
This is a fork of the "Shield FX" mod.
Original: https://mods.factorio.com/mod/Shield-FX
I will delete this mod once the original author updates it.

info.name: Hovercrafts
info.author: Arcani_Victus
info.title: Hovercrafts
info.description: Speed across land and water in your own personal hovercraft. 4 versions: standard, missile, electric, and laser.

info.name: gore_fork
info.title: Gore (Fork 2.1)
info.author: ownlyme
info.description:
This is a fork of the "Gore" mod.
Original: https://mods.factorio.com/mod/gore
I will delete this mod once the original author updates it.

info.name: valves
info.title: Valves
info.description: Adds three seperate animated valves for pipes: overflow, top-up and one-way/check valves. Inspired by Flow Control and Advanced Fluid Handling. The thresholds can be configured using shortcuts. Uses valve functionality provided by Factorio.
info.author: stringweasel

info.name: FluidMustFlow
info.title: Fluid Must Flow
info.author: Linver, Krastor, raiguard
info.description: Adds very large pipes with enormous throughput capabilities.

info.name: its-about-time
info.title: It's About Time!
info.author: binaryDiv
info.description: Displays a clock with the in-game time on the current planet.

info.name: Flare Stack
info.title: Flare Stack
info.author: GotLag
info.description: Adds structures for managing excess production byproducts.

info.name: Inter-Platform-Logistics
info.title: IPL - Inter Platform Logistics
info.author: SirPuck
info.description: Use IPL Antennas on your Space Platforms to allow them to exchange items when at the same space location. Transfer items automatically, using circuits and antennas, directly between space platforms without having to send your items to the ground !

info.name: visible-planets
info.title: Visible Planets in Space
info.author: Nauviax
info.description: Render the local planet behind platforms when in orbit. Now with parallax, rotation, and automatic mod support!

info.name: Better_Starmap_Background
info.author: Tserup
info.title: Better StarMap Background
info.description: Add starry sky backgrounds and asteroid belts to the starmap(customizable).

info.name: Redrawn-Space-Connections
info.author: thesixthroc
info.title: Redrawn Space Connections
info.description:
Algorithmically redraws the routes on the space map to improve navigation between modded planets.

In order to keep this mod effective and composable, it avoids making exceptions or compatibility patches for specific planets, leaving that to other mod authors.

info.name: Placeables
info.title: Placeables: Show items in your inventory that you can build with!
info.author: OmaiGrundles
info.description: A quickbar-inspired dynamic GUI that shows all items you can use for building that is currently in your inventory. Designed for use with megamods (Pyanodon's, Bob's / Angel's, and Krastorio for example) that add so many buildings that the quickbar can't handle them all.

info.name: textplates
info.title: Text Plates
info.author: Earendel, gheift
info.description: Text shaped plates for signs and labels. Letters, numbers and symbols. Large and small variants of: Iron, copper, stone, steel, concrete, glass, gold, and uranium.

info.author: sh4dow
info.description: Extends quality scaling to more entities/properties

info.title: More Quality Scaling

info.name: spoilage-scanner
info.title: Spoilage Scanner
info.author: Krei_
info.description: Adds a spoilage level detector that outputs the freshness level of items inside a container.

info.name: better-victory-screen
info.title: Better Victory Screen
info.description: Upon victory it shows various interesting game statistics, like the total amount of time you spent hand crafting and your peak power production. Can be added to an existing save.
info.author: stringweasel

info.name: lignumis
info.title: Lignumis
info.description: Dive into the world of Lignumis, a moon of Nauvis offering only the most basic technologies.

info.description: Overhaul merging Krastorio 2 with Space Age.
info.author: Polka_37

info.name: planet-muluna
info.title: ○🌐Muluna, Moon of Nauvis
info.description: ○🌐Explore Nauvis' moon of Muluna, and take your first step into space. Revamps the Space Science pack to be crafted on Muluna, and adds a new science pack that allows you to build better space platforms. The surface is devoid of life, but who knows what lurks in the planet's many craters?
info.author: MeteorSwarm

info.name: Cerys-Moon-of-Fulgora
info.title: Cerys
info.author: thesixthroc
info.description:
Fulgora's moon of puzzles. Ancient wrecks embedded in thick ice can seemingly be repaired, including a colossal nuclear reactor that could transform the possibilities on the surface... if you can get it working.

Cerys is a complete and polished mod that does not modify the vanilla game in any way, so is easy to include in existing saves.

info.author: erronius
info.description: Fork of Castra, originally by Bartz24 and LogicDolphin, to fix balance issues.

info.name: maraxsis
info.title: Maraxsis
info.description: Dive into the uncharted waters of Maraxsis, a world where the sea covers everything. Utilize submarines to explore, craft advanced fluids inside the hydro plant, build pressure domes, and master the challenges of deep-sea logistics.

info.name: Moshine

info.description: Hot planet where you develop AI, 33 technologies, 2 new minerals, 7 buildings, many items, custom terrain, music, unique challenges... Doesn't break Space Age balance, integrates well to it
info.author: snouz

info.name: secretas
info.title: Secretas&Frozeta
info.author: ZDK, 2025
info.description: ○🌐This mod adds Secretas and Frotzeta. Secretas is a gas giant. Frozeta is one of its planet sized moon. Frozeta is challenge planet - recycle spaceship scrap - like an ugly love child of Fulgora and Aquilo

info.title: Terra Palus (2.1)
info.author: Lukah, updated by Alex Green
info.description:
Adds a new hybrid planet combining features of Nauvis and Gleba. Brave the dangerous swamp moon of Terra Palus; mine Palusium ore and use UV light to freeze those that would see you destroyed.
Terra Palus by Lukah, updated for Factorio 2.1. Prototype and setting names are unchanged, so a save with the original mod can switch to this one.

info.name: planet-woodoria

info.description: Adds Woodoria, a planet composed entirely of wood. Woodoria is a mystical planet entirely composed of wood, from its surface to its core, made up of diverse wood types. The landscape is blanketed with dense forests of towering, verdant trees, as if the entire world pulses with the life force of wood. The wood here is not only robust but also endowed with unique magical properties, enabling self-repair and regeneration.

info.author: 3of0 (unofficial 2.1 compat fork of CybranM's Armoured Biters)
info.description:
Unofficial Factorio 2.1 compatibility fork of CybranM's Armoured Biters (https://mods.factorio.com/mod/ArmouredBiters), licensed CC BY-NC 4.0 same as the original. Changes: fixed a load-crash caused by a base-game file Armoured Biters depends on that no longer exists in 2.1; Snappers have also been brought up to date with several vanilla biter behaviors that changed in 2.1, restoring the same vanilla parity they had under 2.0. Retire this fork once the original mod supports 2.1.

Adds armoured enemies called Snappers to the game with custom sprites and animations. They've got more health but are slower than regular biters.
